title: LLM Telemetry - Cardinality Guard
description: Is the cardinality bound holding, and is anything unregistered emitting?

panels.title: UNREGISTERED spans (__other__)
panels.description: Spans carrying a dimension value that is not on the allowlist. ANY non-zero value is actionable: a shadow deployment, a new region, or a stale allowlist. Shown as an absolute count, never a share.

targets.rawSql: SELECT countMergeIf(spans, tenant_id = '__other__') + countMergeIf(spans, tenant_tier = '__other__') + countMergeIf(spans, model = '__other__') + countMergeIf(spans, operation = '__other__') + countMergeIf(spans, route = '__other__') + countMergeIf(spans, region = '__other__') + countMergeIf(spans, status_class = '__other__') AS value FROM telemetry.spans_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_minute)

panels.title: Absent dimensions (__none__) - routine
panels.description: Spans that simply do not carry a dimension: a tool span has no model. Expected and ignorable. Kept in its own panel because merging it with __other__ is what previously hid 300 unregistered spans behind 18,243 routine ones.

targets.rawSql: SELECT countMergeIf(spans, tenant_id = '__none__') + countMergeIf(spans, tenant_tier = '__none__') + countMergeIf(spans, model = '__none__') + countMergeIf(spans, operation = '__none__') + countMergeIf(spans, route = '__none__') + countMergeIf(spans, region = '__none__') + countMergeIf(spans, status_class = '__none__') AS value FROM telemetry.spans_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_minute)

panels.title: Rollup rows / minute
panels.description: Worst minute in range. Declared bound is 7,565,788,800 (product of budgets + 2 sentinels) -- a true but loose ceiling, since dimensions correlate heavily in practice.

panels.title: Rollup compression
panels.description: Raw rows per rollup row. If this is near 1, the rollup is not earning its storage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(
    (SELECT sum(rows) FROM system.parts
     WHERE database='telemetry' AND table='spans_raw' AND active)
  / nullIf((SELECT sum(rows) FROM system.parts
     WHERE database='telemetry' AND table='spans_1m' AND active), 0), 1) AS value

panels.title: Which values are unregistered?
panels.description: The offender, by name. Reads spans_raw, because the rollup has already replaced the value with a sentinel -- by then the information needed to act on it is gone by design. This panel is why a 0.6% __other__ share does not require anyone to think to investigate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 'tenant_id' AS "dimension", tenant_id AS "value", count() AS "spans"
FROM telemetry.spans_raw
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND tenant_id != ''
  AND NOT dictHas('telemetry.dim_allowlist_dict', ('tenant_id', tenant_id))
GROUP BY "value"
UNION ALL
SELECT 'tenant_tier' AS "dimension", tenant_tier AS "value", count() AS "spans"
FROM telemetry.spans_raw
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND tenant_tier != ''
  AND NOT dictHas('telemetry.dim_allowlist_dict', ('tenant_tier', tenant_tier))
GROUP BY "value"
UNION ALL
SELECT 'model' AS "dimension", model AS "value", count() AS "spans"
FROM telemetry.spans_raw
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND model != ''
  AND NOT dictHas('telemetry.dim_allowlist_dict', ('model', model))
GROUP BY "value"
UNION ALL
SELECT 'operation' AS "dimension", operation AS "value", count() AS "spans"
FROM telemetry.spans_raw
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND operation != ''
  AND NOT dictHas('telemetry.dim_allowlist_dict', ('operation', operation))
GROUP BY "value"
UNION ALL
SELECT 'route' AS "dimension", route AS "value", count() AS "spans"
FROM telemetry.spans_raw
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND route != ''
  AND NOT dictHas('telemetry.dim_allowlist_dict', ('route', route))
GROUP BY "value"
UNION ALL
SELECT 'region' AS "dimension", region AS "value", count() AS "spans"
FROM telemetry.spans_raw
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND region != ''
  AND NOT dictHas('telemetry.dim_allowlist_dict', ('region', region))
GROUP BY "value"
UNION ALL
SELECT 'status_class' AS "dimension", status_class AS "value", count() AS "spans"
FROM telemetry.spans_raw
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND status_class != ''
  AND NOT dictHas('telemetry.dim_allowlist_dict', ('status_class', status_class))
GROUP BY "value"
) ORDER BY "spans" DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Bucket breakdown by dimension
panels.description: Three separate columns on purpose. A single 'bucketed %' column would average an actionable signal into a routine one.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 'tenant_id' AS "dimension",
       countMergeIf(spans, tenant_id NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "registered",
       countMergeIf(spans, tenant_id = '__other__') AS "UNREGISTERED",
       countMergeIf(spans, tenant_id = '__none__') AS "absent (routine)",
       uniqExactIf(tenant_id, tenant_id NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "distinct values",
       200 AS "budget"
FROM telemetry.spans_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_minute)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'tenant_tier' AS "dimension",
       countMergeIf(spans, tenant_tier NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "registered",
       countMergeIf(spans, tenant_tier = '__other__') AS "UNREGISTERED",
       countMergeIf(spans, tenant_tier = '__none__') AS "absent (routine)",
       uniqExactIf(tenant_tier, tenant_tier NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "distinct values",
       8 AS "budget"
FROM telemetry.spans_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_minute)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'model' AS "dimension",
       countMergeIf(spans, model NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "registered",
       countMergeIf(spans, model = '__other__') AS "UNREGISTERED",
       countMergeIf(spans, model = '__none__') AS "absent (routine)",
       uniqExactIf(model, model NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "distinct values",
       32 AS "budget"
FROM telemetry.spans_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_minute)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'operation' AS "dimension",
       countMergeIf(spans, operation NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "registered",
       countMergeIf(spans, operation = '__other__') AS "UNREGISTERED",
       countMergeIf(spans, operation = '__none__') AS "absent (routine)",
       uniqExactIf(operation, operation NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "distinct values",
       16 AS "budget"
FROM telemetry.spans_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_minute)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'route' AS "dimension",
       countMergeIf(spans, route NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "registered",
       countMergeIf(spans, route = '__other__') AS "UNREGISTERED",
       countMergeIf(spans, route = '__none__') AS "absent (routine)",
       uniqExactIf(route, route NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "distinct values",
       32 AS "budget"
FROM telemetry.spans_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_minute)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'region' AS "dimension",
       countMergeIf(spans, region NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "registered",
       countMergeIf(spans, region = '__other__') AS "UNREGISTERED",
       countMergeIf(spans, region = '__none__') AS "absent (routine)",
       uniqExactIf(region, region NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "distinct values",
       16 AS "budget"
FROM telemetry.spans_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_minute)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'status_class' AS "dimension",
       countMergeIf(spans, status_class NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "registered",
       countMergeIf(spans, status_class = '__other__') AS "UNREGISTERED",
       countMergeIf(spans, status_class = '__none__') AS "absent (routine)",
       uniqExactIf(status_class, status_class NOT IN ('__other__', '__none__')) AS "distinct values",
       8 AS "budget"
FROM telemetry.spans_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_minute)
) ORDER BY "UNREGISTERED" DESC

panels.title: Unregistered spans over time, by dimension
panels.description: __none__ is excluded from this query by construction, so a routine bucket cannot swamp the series. A step change here means someone deployed something the registry does not know about.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts_minute AS time,
       countMergeIf(spans, tenant_id = '__other__') AS "tenant_id", countMergeIf(spans, tenant_tier = '__other__') AS "tenant_tier", countMergeIf(spans, model = '__other__') AS "model", countMergeIf(spans, operation = '__other__') AS "operation", countMergeIf(spans, route = '__other__') AS "route", countMergeIf(spans, region = '__other__') AS "region", countMergeIf(spans, status_class = '__other__') AS "status_class"
FROM telemetry.spans_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_minute)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

options.content:
**`__other__` is actionable. `__none__` is not. They are never combined.**

- **`__other__`** — the span carried a dimension value that is not on the
  allowlist. Something is emitting data the registry does not know about: a
  shadow deployment, a new region, or an allowlist that has gone stale. Fix by
  registering the value in `schemas/clickhouse/dimensions.yaml` and running
  `telemetry-engine dimensions apply`, or by fixing the emitter.
- **`__none__`** — the span does not carry that dimension at all. A tool span
  has no model; an embeddings call has no completion. Routine.

These were one bucket until it was measured: 18,243 routine tool spans shared
it with exactly 300 genuinely unregistered ones, so the totals looked healthy
while the actionable signal was 2% of its own bucket. Every panel here is built
so that cannot recur — absolute counts rather than shares, separate series, and
a panel that names the offending value instead of reporting a percentage.
